title: Workmanship Warranties Outside-Shop Repair and Reimbursement Limits
content:
Where a covered concern is repaired at an outside shop under a Workmanship Warranties plan, the plan's figures below govern authorization, the distance threshold, the reimbursement cap, the invoice window and the payment time.

| Figure | Chip Repair Guarantee | Calibration Workmanship Warranty | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| An outside-shop repair must be authorized by the network before the work is done to be reimbursed | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Distance from the nearest network center beyond which a pre-authorized repair at an outside shop is reimbursed (miles; 0 means never) | 0 | 0 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Most reimbursed for one outside-shop warranty repair (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 350.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 |
| Calendar days after the outside repair within which the paid invoice must be submitted (0 means not applicable) | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Business days to pay an approved reimbursement | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Notes

- **Distance.** Under the Chip Repair Guarantee and the Calibration Workmanship Warranty the distance figure is 0, meaning never: no outside-shop repair is reimbursed. Under the other four plans the figure is 50 miles from the nearest network center.
- **Cap.** The most reimbursed for one outside-shop warranty repair is USD 250 under the Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty, USD 350 under the Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty, USD 1000 under the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and USD 1500 under the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty.
- **Invoice window.** Under the four plans that reimburse outside-shop repairs, the paid invoice must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the outside repair; the figure is 0, not applicable, under the other two.
- **Payment.** An approved reimbursement is paid within 10 business days under every plan.

Q. A customer with a Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty lives 40 miles from the nearest network center (hypothetical figure). Is the distance figure exceeded?
A. No. The plan's figure is 50 miles, and 40 miles does not exceed it.
